title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of the Insurance Law of the People's Republic of China (I)

articles.content_en:
Article 1: For disputes arising from an insurance contract concluded after the Insurance Law comes into force, the provisions of the Insurance Law shall apply. For disputes arising from an insurance contract concluded before the Insurance Law comes into force, except as otherwise provided in this Interpretation, the provisions of the laws in force at that time shall apply; where the laws in force at that time have no provisions, the relevant provisions of the Insurance Law shall apply by reference.
The laws at the time of contract formation shall apply in determining whether an insurance contract is concluded.

Article 2: Where an insurance contract concluded before the Insurance Law comes into force is determined to be invalid under the laws in force at that time but valid under the Insurance Law, the provisions of the Insurance Law shall apply.

Article 3: Where an insurance contract was concluded before the Insurance Law comes into force, but acts or events such as the transfer of the subject matter insured, the occurrence of an insured event, claims settlement, or subrogation occur after the Insurance Law comes into force, the provisions of the Insurance Law shall apply.

Article 4: Where an insurance contract was concluded before the Insurance Law comes into force, and after the Insurance Law comes into force, the insurer claims dissolution of the contract on the grounds that the applicant failed to perform the obligation of truthful disclosure or that the age of the insured was reported untruthfully, the provisions of the Insurance Law shall apply.

Article 6: The provisions of the Insurance Law shall not apply to cases that have been finally adjudicated before the Insurance Law comes into force, or to cases in which a party applies for retrial or initiates a retrial under the adjudication supervision procedure.
